item.title: XNSO announces updated social insurance contribution schedule
item.description: XNSO published the updated contribution schedule for 2027 as required under the Social Insurance Act.

item.title: Social insurance contribution rates set to increase next quarter
item.description: XNSO confirmed contribution rates will increase starting Q1 2027, applying to all private sector employers.

item.title: XNSO issues official circular on contribution table update
item.description: Official circular confirming updated contribution rate tables effective Q1 2027.

item.title: Xanadu introduces mandatory health insurance for part-time workers
item.description: New regulation mandates health insurance for part-time workers over 20 hrs/week, effective 1 July 2027.
